From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood-inference.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.l@novacare.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft shoot plan + release/forms for NovaCare product story

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for agreeing to share NovaCare's experience with the new inference pipeline. I put together a compact one-day shoot plan that keeps the on-site time under 6 hours and focuses on two main segments: (1) executive intro / product context (Devon or Emma) and (2) clinician workflow b-roll + short on-camera QA.

Attachments: release_form_v2.pdf (signature required), one_day_shotlist.xlsx (run of show), on-camera-qa.docx (sample prompts).

Key asks from your side:
- Confirm available date windows (we proposed Jun 9 or Jun 16).
- Who will be the on-camera primary (Emma or Devon)?
- Any legal/privacy flags on filming areas or patient-adjacent content — if so, loop in Legal and provide the do-not-film zones.

Logistics note: Our crew will bring a minimal footprint kit (two cameras, lavs, LED panels). We can provide event insurance and a copy of our certificate on request.

Next steps I propose: quick 20-min sync next week to lock the date and final sign-off on the release. If that's fine, I'll send the DocuSign link for the release_form_v2 and a calendar invite with Ben + Marissa.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Partnerships | Redwood Inference
naomi.f@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Naomi —

Thanks for the clear plan. Jun 16 works best for us (we're booked the 9th). We'll aim to have Devon on camera for the exec piece and I can arrange for two clinicians for the workflow shots.

A few quick notes from Legal (copied):
- Please confirm that no patient faces or PHI will be captured. We can allow b-roll of equipment and clinician hands, plus staged workflow with consented staff.
- We need the release signed by the on-camera people and a short waiver for facilities.

Also: can you confirm estimated on-site start time? Our staff shift change is at 08:00 so we'd prefer shoot after 09:00.

I'll review the attached documents with Legal and get back if there are redlines. If you can send the DocuSign link, we can get signatures before the shoot.

Appreciate the compact schedule.

Hi Emma / Naomi —

Quick logistics note from production:
- Crew: Ben (DP), 1 audio tech, 1 producer (me). We'll need one reserved parking space and access to the main lobby for kit drop.
- approx. kit footprint: 2 rolling cases, 1 flight case, 3 stands.
- We'll bring two lav mics + one on-camera boom. If clinicians will be moving across the floor, lavs are ideal.

Interview prep: attached is a 1-page prep sheet with suggested talking points and guardrails for PHI. Please share with Devon and the clinicians.

On the release: we prefer DocuSign for signatures to make day-of check-in quick. If Legal needs to redline, a PDF with comments first is fine — either way we need signed forms at least 48 hours before craft call so we can prep name badges and release checklists.

Questions for NovaCare:
1) Who will be the day-of point of contact for staff coordination?
2) Any restricted zones (bio labs, patient rooms) we should avoid?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marissa Cole
Producer, Redwood Inference Creative Ops
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
